item.title: slob life nu dada
item.description: The entirely unanticipated EP by love sella. 44.1 KHz compositions for cyberwitches/-bitches. Kill all money: Your virtue is predispositioned. Credits All tracks composed, performed, recorded, engineered, enchanted, bounced, bit-flipped, posted and abandoned by love sella. Track 2: Kalimba played by Damian Been. Title based on a post by Ma3ke. Track 4: Vocals sang by Jørgen Bruinsma Special thanks to Damian Been, Ma3ke, Jørgen, Discogs, Plato Groningen.

item.title: Amersfoort Tracks
item.description: Jungle Tracks created on the Dutch National Railways. Composed, recorded and mixed on trains connected to Amersfoort Central Station between April 1st, 2024 and May 20th, 2024. Credits All tracks composed, performed, recorded, engineered, licked, youtube-to-mp3 downloaded and decimated by DJ ZITwerK. Special thanks to Bille, Gay Bitches, NS Personnel, My SP404MkII.

item.title: Up in Flames
item.description: Two “tape jams”, performed on my bedroom floor, captured towards the end of summer 2024. Credits Mastering, mixing, performance, photography, production, sampling by Aching Hands. Artwork by Lucas Veerkamp. Additional mastering provided by Robin van Ulft. Additional samples provided by Tim Kahn. Much, much love (alphabetical) Damian Been, Puk Bruinsma, Benjamin Burger, Dylan Hokstam, Max for Live, Mlem Records (and everyone involved), Midas Munsterman, Robin van Ulft, Lucas Veerkamp, Geart Vledder.

item.title: Pieces of Peace
item.description: 17 pieces of peace written between the chaotic ages of 14-19. One day my sibling called me up while I was pondering, lying on my brand new mattress after I’d just moved out. Saying: “Hey chef, remember those songs we recorded?” And of course I did, that’s what had been on my mind. That’s what I was lying there for. Credits Songwriting, lyrics, artwork and iPhone recording engineering by Jørgen Valdemar.

item.title: Wacko_
item.description: Wacko_ follows a narrative of “weirdifaction” —a bright sonic world that gradually unveils a creeping sense of absurdity. The album is the first album written, and recorded, by Cage.log. It is an IndieTronica/Art-pop album that blends Jazz, Funk, IDM, and Ambient influences. Credits Written by Cage.Log. Recorded by Cage.Log. Conceptualised by Dylan Hokstam. Electric bass played by Cage.log. Drum Tracks bitten through by Cage.log. Electronic elements produced by CDL. Lyrics by Cage.

item.title: Denken Aan Een Ander Is Niet Van Deze Tijd
item.description: NL Hoe ga je om met de verschrikkelijke tragedie dat het leven van een geprivilegieerd persoon in de 21e eeuw is? Hoe blijf je jezelf in een wereld die steeds groter en enger wordt? Dat vraagt Ulf Ten Aar zich al een tijdlang af. In diens album “Denken Aan Een Ander Is Niet Van Deze Tijd” is die met beeldende, maatschappijkritische woorden en een stapel zelfspot een stuk dichterbij het antwoord gekomen.

item.title: About
item.description: Mlem Records is a netlabel run by aliens in cyberspace. Netlabel? Yeah! Netlabels are record labels that distribute music online. To us, being a netlabel means we love making music and we love giving that music to friends. So we prioritise accessibility, independence and fun. Any Mlem release is yours now! We’ve already given it to you, friend! Please share stuff with more friends if you think they might like it.
